title: [policy] No-polling compliance
description: Push-based event handling over polling. Policy: use interrupts/callbacks instead of sleep loops. Each code section with potential polling needs a compliance check.
close_reason: No-polling compliance already implemented. Zephyr firmware uses callback-based RX with blocking lora_recv() (not polling). Python uses asyncio event-driven patterns. All sleep calls are for acceptable purposes: LED timing, USB readiness, error backoff. No busy-wait polling found in project code. Third-party tools (libcoap, tinydtls) are out of scope.
